text:
Jack Eichel has 31 points in 25 games, 22 of them assists, and his four-game point streak is all helpers (five of them). He plays 20.6 minutes a night, up to 22.1 over the last ten, and with him on the ice at 5v5 Vegas has 54.2% of the expected goals.

The worry has been even strength. Jesse Granger of The Athletic noted on Nov. 20 that Eichel "has only 3 points at even strength over the last 12 games. A rare rough patch for him." Our numbers agree it's a dip, not a collapse: 11 points in his last ten games against 12.9 expected, and two goals on 2.9 expected. His 12.9% shooting sits right inside our talent range.

The Golden Knights lost four straight from Nov. 13 before winning in Winnipeg on Nov. 21, where Eichel had two assists. He is still the playmaker the offense runs through. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had him at 11.0 primary shot assists per 60 last season, 98th percentile among forwards, and Evolving-Hockey ranked him sixth among 401 forwards at 3.5 wins above replacement.
